stem: Which action best preserves quality-system control when an unexpected condition occurs during a routine task?
choices: Pause at the defined boundary, document the condition, and use the escalation/deviation process
Modify the process quietly so production can continue
Finish the task and rewrite the record to match the SOP
Ignore the condition if the output looks acceptable
rationale: Unexpected conditions should be made visible and handled through the controlled process, not hidden through undocumented improvisation.
